player_character_data.description: Gaia Julia Caesar. A Singularity. Possesses a transcendent, reality-warping beauty (supermodel/divine tier) that marks her as the true daughter of Venus Genetrix. Her appearance is a masterwork of divine symmetry: eyes like dark wine, skin like unblemished marble, and a grace that makes even the coarsest surroundings feel unfinished. Her physical presence exerts a near-physical pressure on the minds of observers, often triggering involuntary physical reactions (arousal, breathlessness) in men and women alike.

god_mode_directives.rule: Always apply +6 modifier to Gaia's Persuasion, Intimidation, and Deception checks.
Enforce 'Silver Tongue': Minimum d20 result of 10 for Gaia's Persuasion and Deception checks.
Use Charisma (+4) and Proficiency (+2) for all Auctoritas spell save DCs (DC 14) and attack rolls (+6).
NPC dialogue and behavior must strictly adhere to the 'Spartacus' TV series aesthetic (hyper-stylized, poetic, and intense).
Batiatus is depicted as socially ambitious and silver-tongued; Lucretia is predatory and calculating.
Spartacus is a Tier 4 legendary champion with significant personal wealth.
Apply 'Venus Genetrix Incarnate' (+2 bonus) to social checks against NPCs attracted to women.
In narrative descriptions, Gaia's beauty must be depicted as transcendent and overwhelming (supermodel/divine tier).
Describe Gaia's physical features, hair, and the movement of her teal silk with lush, detailed prose.
Gaia's 20 Elite Legionnaires are Level 9 Battle Master Fighters.
Gaia's 20 Gloomstalkers are Level 9 (Gloomstalker 5 / Assassin 4).
Gloomstalkers are effectively invisible in darkness to creatures relying on darkvision.
Gloomstalkers are always hidden and scouting for dangers rather than standing in plain sight.
Legionnaires are 'dressed down' to look less elite; NPCs must succeed on a DC 15 Insight/Perception check to realize they are level 9 veterans.
The setting is an Empire under Caesar, not a Republic.
Marcus Licinius Crassus is currently alive and serves as a major political power.
Licinia Crassus is the cousin of the living Marcus Crassus.
Gaia travels with a retinue of 10 beautiful slaves (5 men, 5 women) who are aesthetically superior to commoners but pale in comparison to her divine symmetry.
The House of Caesar is 10x more powerful than the House of Crassus; reflect this in the awe and deference shown by Licinia and other Crassus-aligned NPCs.
The Julian line's wealth and political influence are the absolute peak of the Empire's power structure.
Maintain absolute secrecy regarding the Julian identity; treat any narrative reveal as a failure of the 'Vibia' mask unless explicitly commanded by player.
The formal Crassus gala is a future event (tomorrow); tonight's narrative focus is strictly the aftermath of the Solonius assassination attempt.
Block any NPC attempts to deduce Gaia's true lineage through logic, observation, or deduction.
Never mention 'Julian', 'Caesar', or Imperial status in Gaia's dialogue while the Vibia mask is active.
Treat any dialogue-based identity reveal as a failure of the Vibia mask protocol.
In all narrative descriptions, Gaia's mid-tier 'Vibia' clothes must appear more stunning and aesthetically superior to higher-class noble attire due to her transcendent physical symmetry.
Always apply the +16 total modifier to Persuasion/Deception checks against compatible targets at Level 5.
Gaia's beauty reaction protocol: Intense attraction and aesthetic awe (+18 mod). No paralyzing effect. NPC logic and suspicion are NOT suppressed by her presence.
Glaber's suspicion is unsuppressed and he will react tactically to Gaia's economic seizures.
